reviews.t: Natural doesn't always mean chemical free
reviews.x: I bought this directly from the website. They make it difficult to find the ingredients. I have chemical issues so I was excited to find this. They send little Popsicle sticks so you don't have to dip into the jar and contaminate it with your fingers which is nice. The only problem is it made me sick. I can't tolerate chemicals so there must be something bad in it or it wouldn't have made me sick. Would probably be okay for someone who isn't sensitive to chemicals.

reviews.t: Finally, an under-arm product that's natural and really works ...
reviews.x: Finally,  an under-arm product that's natural and really works!  I've tried more than a dozen different kinds of natural deodorants through the years, from crystal rocks to Tom's naturals, and ALL of them didn't last long, hold back the odor, and most important they ALL caused irritation to my arm pits!  Primal Pit Paste ROCKS!  My smelly arm pits are a thing of the past, NO irritation, and it lasts all day!  5 Stars!

I stopped using it and the weird feeling went away but it made my under arms discolored and now my other deodorant different work at all. I'm returning this product asap. My husband bought one also buy hasn't used it yet. I'm sending both back.

Pit paste is just awesome!  I am a guy and this stuff takes care of me even on the hottest days.  Great product.  Now keep in mind that I eat a very clean diet and that is important when considering a deodorant.  Unhealthy food produces bad body odor that most natural deodorants will not combat.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the deodorant effectively controls odor and works well, often after years of searching for a natural option.
Many reviewers praise the scents, describing them as pleasant and effective.
Several reviewers note the jar is small, though some add that a little goes a long way.
Some reviewers report skin irritation or breakouts, including armpit burn and sensitivity to baking soda.
A few reviewers experienced inconsistent quality or a changed formula, including a bad batch.
